_readme: FROZEN CONTRACT for GET /api/me. Note it returns 200 with rider:null when logged out -- never 401. A 401 here would make the ordinary anonymous visit look like an error to every caller.
_invariants: needs_team is the ONE authoritative trigger for the team picker. The client must not infer it from a URL fragment or from team===null anywhere else.

scope is 'read_all' or 'read'. 'read' means the rider unchecked private activities on Strava's consent screen: they stay fully functional, their public rides count, and the UI badges that private rides are not counted. It is never a lockout.
revoked true means the rider revoked access at Strava. Their row, team, and history all survive so their total freezes rather than vanishing mid-race.

competition is the SAME block GET /api/leaderboard returns and describes ONE SELECTED MONTH. /api/me accepts the same ?month=YYYY-MM, and the client must send the identical value to both boot calls -- otherwise the masthead describes a different month than the board rendered beside it. Both endpoints also compute first_month/last_month the same way, from the database rather than from config alone, or the masthead would advertise a narrower picker than the board it sits above.
